note: One browser pipeline. Picture stack: DOM/SVG, GSAP seek(t), Lucide, sparse Lottie, Three.js on demand, then a WebGL post pass. Remotion, Motion, and Rive are inspirations, not dependencies. Playwright captures seek(t) frames and ffmpeg encodes them.

components.purpose: One number hits the frame, then shrinks into a chart. One number per beat.
Two-bar comparison. The spoken line carries only one of the two numbers.
A single stamp for one rule or one wasted stop.
A character plays an action on the beat. Idle beside a chart fails QC.
Tips are on-screen cards. The voice does not read first, second, third.

motion.clock: gsap timeline paused:true, seek(t) or totalProgress from pipeline t

implementations.note: Playwright frame capture and ffmpeg. Draft renders carry the watermark Not human-reviewed. Release renders require a human sign-off.
